baseline.note: Clean, on-brief and tight, but voice is polished and generic; 'Weighted for the long page' is the only real hook.

storyscope.note: Distinct workshop voice, concrete details (five $2 coins, keys in bag), honest and specific; I would run this.

writing-skill.note: Accurate but flat and repetitive, reads like a spec sheet; over length and little personality.

merged.note: Warm, charming cat line, but adds unsupported 'made by hand' and the weight section is thinner than B.
